messages:
maya: Created RC build `20260320-rc3` for service `inference-api`. Preparing for prod promotion during the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tonight. Includes DB schema migration (backwards compatible), KV cache opt-in behind flag, and model pin to `redwood-v2.1-q`. Need quick sign-offs and confirm rollback plan (revert to `rc2`) is OK. Posting canary plan and rollout schedule below. @samir you are on PD for the window.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: RC artifact `20260320-rc3` created. CI: unit ✅ integration ✅ e2e ✅ smoke ✅. Canary schedule queued.

aj: does this RC include the KV cache change that was discussed last week? That changes latency profiles.

maya: yes — `kvcache_v2` is bundled but will be OFF by default outside canary. Canary will enable it at 20% only. If issues, we can flip it off quickly.

samir: ran the migration and smoke locally against a snapshot. No schema issues. Suggest bumping healthcheck timeout to 60s in the service start script to avoid transient failures during rollout.

lina: agree with the healthcheck timeout. Also recommend pinning the model to `redwood-v2.1-quant` to avoid float drift. Ops: any cost/regression concerns?

opsbot: opsbot: Reminder — change window confirmed 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pager: @samir (primary), @maya (backup).

aj: +1 for healthcheck timeout. Can we add a brief note in the release notes about possible short-term p95 regressions for >8k contexts?

maya: good call, added a release note entry: "minor p95 regression on very long contexts due to KV cache warmup" and instructions to revert the flag. Updated release notes URL below. Also change the canary schedule: 20% -> 50% after 10m -> 100% after 30m if stable.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary started (20%) in infra-prod-east. Health checks: OK. Metrics snapshot: p50=25ms, p95=220ms, error_rate=0.02%.

lina: logs look clean, no spike in 5xx. :thumbsup:

samir: watching traces — no obvious regressions. Will escalate if errors >0.5% in next 10m.

maya: waiting 10m for metrics to settle, then promote to 50%. Objectors?

aj: no objections from me.

lina: no objections.

maya: promoting to 50% now. Triggering deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to 50% in progress. Rolling updates to east cluster: 12/12 instances updated. Post-update health: OK. Canary health stable after 12m.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% initiated. Applying prod tag `rc3-prod-20260320`. Gateway routes pinned to new instance group.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Promotion to 100% complete. All regions: success. Final metrics: p50=26ms, p95=230ms, error_rate=0.03%. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026-03-20-rc3

maya: Thanks everyone — tagging release notes and closing this thread. Rollback plan remains: if any major incident, run `kubectl set image` to revert deployment to `rc2` image and disable `kvcache_v2` flag. :white_check_mark: 

aj: thanks, great coordination.

lina: nice work.

samir: oncall staying glued to alerts for the window.

maya: end of thread."
